Code, AI and the review challenge

takeaways: Power Platform has moved from low-code productivity through fusion development to AI-native fusion, where AI joins the team without eliminating existing roles.
AI makes building apps fast, but maintainability, security, architecture and a disciplined ALM with Git as the single source of truth still decide success.
Reza Niroomand's XRM Tools brings plug-in and custom API registration into code inside Visual Studio, while PSDataverse uses PowerShell to move large volumes of data reliably in and out of Dataverse.
hook: AI lets anyone build an app in minutes, but who keeps it maintainable and secure? Mirko Peters and Microsoft MVP Reza Niroomand discuss AI-native fusion development, ALM, Git and Terraform for Power Platform makers, developers and architects, plus the tools XRM Tools and PSDataverse.
